title: Revision Rhinoplasty in Türkiye: Why It Requires Extra Caution & Time

metaDescription: Planning revision rhinoplasty in Türkiye? Learn the 12-month wait rule, rib-cartilage graft factors, portfolio checks, and safe Istanbul stay length.
quickAnswer: A revision rhinoplasty turkey plan demands more patience, stricter vetting, and a longer Istanbul stay than a first nose job. Most surgeons advise waiting at least 12 months before re-operating, factoring in rib-cartilage graft recovery, checking 12-month revision outcomes, and staying 10 to 12 nights before flying. body.text: How long must you wait after a first nose job before revision?

Surgeons generally advise waiting a minimum of 12 months after primary rhinoplasty before performing revision surgery. Full nasal healing takes up to a year—and sometimes longer in thick-skinned nasal tips—so operating prematurely on swollen, stiff scar tissue increases unpredictability and compromises delicate blood supply.

Early post-operative asymmetries often soften as lymphatic drainage recovers over months six through twelve. Exceptions to the 12-month wait are strictly clinical decisions made by a licensed surgeon, typically limited to severe airway obstruction, displaced grafts, or structural collapse. Pushing for an early revision abroad simply because a clinic offers an open calendar slot is a major warning sign highlighted in [BAAPS cosmetic tourism safety guidance](https://baaps.org.uk/patients/safety_in_surgery/cosmetic_tourism.aspx).
Why do rib-cartilage grafts increase operative time and cost?

In many revision rhinoplasty turkey cases, the nasal septum has already been harvested or weakened during the first operation, requiring structural cartilage from the ear or rib (costal cartilage). Harvesting, carving, and securing rib cartilage adds a second surgical site, extends general anaesthesia time, and demands higher technical precision—raising hospital, anaesthesia, and surgeon fees.

Rib-cartilage grafting also changes your day-to-day recovery logistics. Patients experience chest-wall soreness alongside nasal swelling, making sitting up, carrying luggage, and sleeping flat more uncomfortable during the first week. You may need one to two nights in a full-service accredited hospital rather than a quick next-morning discharge. For baseline primary timelines and hospital credential checks, see our guide on [rhinoplasty in Istanbul 2026](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/blog/rhinoplasty-istanbul-2026).

body.text: What specific revision portfolio proof should you verify?

Rather than relying on filtered operating-table photos taken immediately after closure, verify standardised before-and-after revision cases photographed at 12 months or later in consistent lighting from front, profile, oblique, and basal (under-tip) angles. Ask specifically for cases matching your anatomy—such as pinched tips, saddle-nose deformities, or thick nasal skin.

Follow the [ISAPS Patient Safety Diamond](https://www.isaps.org/media/dydp5pmm/montserrat_medical-tourism-english.pdf), which stresses verifying the surgeon's qualifications, the patient's suitability, the specific procedure, and the regulatory accreditation of the surgical facility.

items: Request your original operative report from your first surgeon so the revision specialist knows what cartilage remains.

Verify the hospital's [Turkish Ministry of Health International Health Tourism Authorization Certificate](https://shgmturizmdb.saglik.gov.tr/EN-69289/healthcare-providers-with-international-health-tourism-authorization-certificates.html).

Confirm you will have a direct, unhurried consultation with the operating surgeon before paying a non-refundable fee, as advised by the [NHS cosmetic surgery abroad guide](https://www.nhs.uk/tests-and-treatments/cosmetic-procedures/advice/cosmetic-surgery-abroad/).
Review unedited 12-month healed revision photos rather than 7-day cast-removal clips.
Ask in writing what follow-up pathway applies once you return home.

body.text: How many nights in Istanbul are safe before flying home?

While [NHS](https://www.nhs.uk/tests-and-treatments/cosmetic-procedures/advice/cosmetic-surgery-abroad/) and [BAPRAS](https://www.bapras.org.uk/public/patient-information/cosmetic-surgery/cosmetic-surgery-abroad) advise waiting at least 7 to 10 days before flying after facial cosmetic procedures, revision rhinoplasty—especially with rib-cartilage harvesting—warrants 10 to 12 nights in Istanbul. Extra ground time covers delayed cast removal, rib-incision dressing checks, and a calm recovery buffer before cabin pressure changes and airport walking.

faq.q: Can a revision rhinoplasty fix both breathing and appearance?
faq.a: Licensed ENT and plastic surgeons frequently address both airway obstruction and nasal shape in a single revision, though your surgeon must determine what is clinically achievable after examining your internal anatomy.

faq.q: Is donor (cadaveric) rib cartilage used instead of my own rib?
faq.a: Some surgeons offer autologous (your own) rib cartilage while others discuss irradiated donor cartilage; the clinical pros, cons, and resorption risks must be weighed directly with your licensed surgeon.

faq.q: Should I travel alone for revision rhinoplasty with a rib graft?
faq.a: Travelling with a companion is strongly advisable because rib-site soreness limits lifting suitcases, opening heavy doors, and managing pharmacy runs during the first 72 to 96 hours.

faq.q: Why do operating-table photos not prove revision quality?
faq.a: Immediate post-operative photos show zero healing, scar contraction, or graft settling. True structural stability only becomes visible after swelling subsides over 12 months.

faq.q: What documents should I carry home from my Istanbul hospital?
faq.a: Request your English-language operative report, details of any grafts placed, discharge medication list, and written fit-to-fly clearance before leaving the hospital or clinic.
